$comment: Pricing dataset for costperrun.com. All prices are USD per 1,000,000 tokens. cachedInput is the cache-READ rate. Every entry carries a sourceUrl and a verifiedAt date.

notes.cacheReads: Most providers discount cache reads ~90% off input. Anthropic prices cache hits at 10% of input.
notes.cacheWrites: OpenAI publishes a cache-WRITE column for every GPT-5.6 model at exactly 1.25x uncached input. Not represented in cachedInput and not modelled in the calculator.
notes.tokenizers: Providers use different tokenizers, so cross-vendor token counts are approximate.
notes.batchApi: Anthropic and OpenAI batch APIs cut both input and output ~50%. Not yet modelled.
notes.longContext: Three providers raise rates above a context threshold, and this dataset lists the BASE tier in each case. OpenAI GPT-5.6 short context vs long: Sol 4/20 -> 8/30, Terra 2/12 -> 4/18, Luna 0.20/1.20 -> 0.40/1.80. Gemini 3.1 Pro 2/12 -> 4/18 and Gemini 2.5 Pro 1.25/10 -> 2.50/15 above 200K. Grok doubles all rates at >=200K.
notes.peakOffPeak: DeepSeek bills peak and off-peak rates. Off-peak is half of peak. Peak is 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday. This dataset lists PEAK.
notes.promotionalRates: Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.7 Flash are on promotional rates through 2026-12-31 and double on 2027-01-01. Listed at the rate in force today, same as Claude Sonnet 5's introductory rate. See pendingChanges.

pendingChanges.change: Introductory pricing ends. input 2.00 -> 3.00, output 10.00 -> 15.00, cachedInput 0.20 -> 0.30
